name: Zero Small-Scale Source Indicator
statement: After a coordinate reflection making the nonempty class union closed and after suppressing constants, every graph source has empty retained positive separator system; equivalently, $\eta_0(C)=0$.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty binary class, considered up to signed-coordinate equivalence and suppression of constants.
comments: In a fixed union-closed orientation this condition is $\varepsilon_0=0$; minimizing over reflections gives the graph-class formulation.
